Mail._comment: SendEnabled=false: emails are captured for the on-screen popup but never sent. Set Mail__SendEnabled=true ONLY on the live App Service configuration to enable real sending. The test site must never set it.

Cors._comment: Cross-origin hosts allowed to call the API. Empty = no cross-origin access (fail closed). Set per environment, e.g. [ "https://helpdesk.yourdomain.gov" ].
